title: Frame perspectives for process matrices: from coordinate parametrization to spacetime representation
summary: We study how to implement and transform frame perspectives for quantum processes in the process-matrix formalism. We argue that, for pure processes, the causal reference frames (CRF)and time-delocalized subsystems (TDS) formalisms should be understood as coordinate parametrizations of a single perspective-neutral higher-order object. A genuine perspective arises when one endows the process with additional frame data by choosing an operational foliation into circuit fragments (events). With this distinction, existing no-go results acquire a clear scope: they rule out unitary transformations…
